_notes.backend: Firebase Firestore project 'fc-pwa', accessed via public REST API — no auth token required for these paths
_notes.aoy_points_formula: points = pointsMax - (rank-1) * pointsDecrement, per tournament-series-leaderboards/{lbId} config (pointsMax=200, pointsDecrement=2 for 2025 NVKBA series); registered-but-unscored anglers get pointsRegistration (20) as floor. Verified: Lee Richman rank=11 in tournament -> pointsFromRank=180 = 200-(11-1)*2. Cumulative season points/rank are pre-computed in tournament-series-ranks (matches AOY standings page exactly, e.g. rank=96 points=40).
